import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, cap, flow, rev;
        Edge(int to, int cap, int flow, int rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static class Flow {
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> g;
        int[] d, ptr;
        int INF = 1000000000;

        Flow(int nodes) {
            g = new ArrayList<>(nodes);
            for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            d = new int[nodes];
            ptr = new int[nodes];
        }

        void addEdge(int v, int u, int cap) {
            Edge a = new Edge(u, cap, 0, 0);
            Edge b = new Edge(v, 0, 0, 0);
            g.get(v).add(a);
            g.get(u).add(b);
            a.rev = g.get(u).size() - 1;
            b.rev = g.get(v).size() - 1;
        }

        boolean buildLevel(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(d, INF);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            d[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g.get(v)) {
                    if (d[e.to] == INF && e.cap > e.flow) {
                        d[e.to] = d[v] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[t] != INF;
        }

        int dfs(int v, int t, int pushed) {
            if (v == t) return pushed;
            for (; ptr[v] < g.get(v).size(); ptr[v]++) {
                Edge e = g.get(v).get(ptr[v]);
                int cf = e.cap - e.flow;
                if (d[e.to] == d[v] + 1 && cf > 0) {
                    int add = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(pushed, cf));
                    if (add > 0) {
                        e.flow += add;
                        g.get(e.to).get(e.rev).flow -= add;
                        return add;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxflow(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0;
            while (buildLevel(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                int add;
                while ((add = dfs(s, t, INF)) > 0) flow += add;
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static final int N = 11;
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int MAXV = 2 * N * N + 5;
    static int n, tbad;
    static char[][] a = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] b = new char[N][N];
    static int[][] badDist = new int[N][N];
    static int[][] curDist = new int[N][N];
    static int[] dx = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 0, -1, 1};

    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n &&
               a[x][y] != 'Y' && a[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfsGrid(int sx, int sy, int[][] dist, boolean isBadSource) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] v = q.poll();
            int x = v[0], y = v[1];
            if (!isBadSource && dist[x][y] == badDist[x][y]) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dx[k];
                int ny = y + dy[k];
                if (ok(nx, ny) && dist[nx][ny] == INF &&
                    dist[x][y] + 1 <= badDist[nx][ny]) {
                    dist[nx][ny] = dist[x][y] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        tbad = sc.nextInt();
        int px = 0, py = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') { px = i; py = j; }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                b[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        bfsGrid(px, py, badDist, true);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                badDist[i][j] = Math.min(badDist[i][j], tbad);

        Flow flow = new Flow(MAXV);
        int source = 0;
        int sink = 2 * n * n + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] != '0')
                    flow.addEdge(source, i * n + j + 1, a[i][j] - '0');
                if (b[i][j] != '0')
                    flow.addEdge(i * n + j + 1 + n * n, sink, b[i][j] - '0');
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (!ok(i, j)) continue;
                bfsGrid(i, j, curDist, false);
                for (int i1 = 0; i1 < n; i1++) {
                    for (int j1 = 0; j1 < n; j1++) {
                        if (ok(i1, j1) && curDist[i1][j1] <= badDist[i1][j1])
                            flow.addEdge(i * n + j + 1, i1 * n + j1 + 1 + n * n, INF);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(flow.maxflow(source, sink));
    }
}
